title: Git & GitHub Essentials
description: Master version control from day one. Practice commits, branching, merging, pull requests, stashing, and safe undo workflows in an interactive Git terminal.
outcomes: Track files cleanly with git init, git status, git add, and atomic commits
Create, switch, and merge feature branches without losing work
Collaborate with remotes using git push, git pull, and Pull Requests
Recover safely from mistakes using git stash, git restore, and git revert
Follow a production team workflow from branch creation to merged PR
